description.value: A Subway franchise located in Tsawwassen Commons, a retail centre near the Tsawwassen Ferry Terminal and BC Ferries routes. The restaurant offers made-to-order sandwiches, wraps, and salads with breakfast service and catering available. For cyclists passing through the Tsawwassen area, it is a reliable resupply stop with vegetarian and limited vegan options.
